def _fill_missing_statistics(model: nn.Module, statistics: Dict[str, Dict[
    str, int]]) ->Dict[str, Dict[str, int]]:
    # Get all module names from the model
    model_modules = set()
    
    def get_module_names(module, prefix=""):
        for name, child in module.named_modules():
            if name:  # Skip the root module
                full_name = prefix + ("." if prefix else "") + name
                model_modules.add(full_name)
                get_module_names(child, full_name)
    
    get_module_names(model)
    
    # Ensure all model modules have entries in statistics
    result = {}
    for module_name in model_modules:
        if module_name in statistics:
            result[module_name] = statistics[module_name].copy()
        else:
            # Create empty entry with zero values for all statistic types
            # We need to determine what statistic types exist
            if not result:  # First iteration - find statistic types from existing data
                stat_types = set()
                for stat_dict in statistics.values():
                    stat_types.update(stat_dict.keys())
                # Create entry with zero values for all statistic types
                result[module_name] = {stat_type: 0 for stat_type in stat_types}
            else:
                # Use existing stat types from first module
                first_module_stats = next(iter(statistics.values()))
                result[module_name] = {stat_type: 0 for stat_type in first_module_stats}
    
    # Also copy any existing statistics that might be for the root or other modules
    for module_name, stat_dict in statistics.items():
        if module_name in model_modules or module_name == "":
            result[module_name] = stat_dict.copy()
    
    # Handle the case where we want to make sure all modules are present
    # and fill missing ones with zeros
    if not result:
        # If no modules were found, just return the original statistics
        return statistics
    
    # Make sure we have all the model modules
    for module_name in model_modules:
        if module_name not in result:
            # Find the statistic types from existing data
            stat_types = set()
            for stat_dict in statistics.values():
                stat_types.update(stat_dict.keys())
            result[module_name] = {stat_type: 0 for stat_type in stat_types}
    
    return result
